references.text: Jazer is mentioned as a Levitical city given to the children of Gad, confirming its belonging to the tribe of Gad.
Describes Jazer and the Gilead region that were given to the tribes of Gad and Reuben, the same territory referred to in Joshua 13:25.
Mentions that the children of Gad built Aroer, which is the boundary marker noted in Joshua 13:25.
Refers to the land of the Ammonites and their borders toward their territory, which is relevant for the boundary description in Joshua 13:25.
Describes Gilead and the border of the Ammonites, corresponding to the area described in Joshua 13:25.
Mentions Aroer and the region from Aroer to Minnith, the same boundary area as in Joshua 13:25.
Mentions Rabbah, which is the city of Rabbah in the land of the Ammonites, noted as a reference point in Joshua 13:25.
Jazer is mentioned in the prophecy against Moab, the same city referred to as a boundary point in Joshua 13:25.
The prophecy against the Ammonites mentions Rabbah and surrounding cities, relating to the area described in Joshua 13:25.
